headword: {炭素中立|たんそちゅうりつ}

definitions.explanation: A state in which the amount of carbon dioxide released is balanced by an equal amount removed or offset, giving net-zero emissions. The native-word equivalent of カーボンニュートラル.

examples.japanese: {政府|せいふ}は{炭素中立|たんそちゅうりつ}を{目指|めざ}している。
examples.english: The government is aiming for carbon neutrality.

examples.japanese: {炭素中立|たんそちゅうりつ}の{実現|じつげん}には{時間|じかん}がかかる。
examples.english: Achieving carbon neutrality will take time.

examples.japanese: {多|おお}くの{国|くに}が2050{年|ねん}までの{炭素中立|たんそちゅうりつ}を{宣言|せんげん}している。
examples.english: Many countries have declared carbon neutrality by 2050.

notes:
The native (Sino-Japanese) term for carbon neutrality, formed from {炭素|たんそ} (carbon) + {中立|ちゅうりつ} (neutrality). In everyday news the loanword カーボンニュートラル is more common, while {炭素中立|たんそちゅうりつ} appears in more formal or technical writing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {炭素中立|たんそちゅうりつ}を{目指|めざ}す: to aim for carbon neutrality
- {炭素中立|たんそちゅうりつ}を{実現|じつげん}する: to achieve carbon neutrality
- {炭素中立|たんそちゅうりつ}{社会|しゃかい}: a carbon-neutral society

SIMILAR WORDS:
- カーボンニュートラル: carbon neutral — the more common loanword with the same meaning
- カーボンオフセット: carbon offset — one method used to move toward carbon neutrality
